data.description:
## Purpose

`rebar metrics`'s structural metrics (module size, complexity, duplication) require three
external tools that no bootstrap path installs, so they have reported `unavailable` in this
repository since they shipped. rebar has never dogfooded its own code-health metrics.

Operator request 2026-08-05: install them on this machine AND make new venvs in this project
get them.

## Machine setup -- DONE, recorded here for reproducibility

    brew install scc            -> scc 3.7.0 at /opt/homebrew/bin/scc
    npm install -g jscpd        -> jscpd (cpd) 5.0.14 at /opt/homebrew/bin/jscpd
    uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python lizard==1.23.0

Result: `complexity_summary` and `duplication_summary` now return real values (jscpd reports
1528 clones, 4.27%). The scc-backed size metrics do NOT -- see the sibling bug on the missing
`--by-file` flag.

## What this ticket changes

1. `Makefile` `install` target: `uv sync --locked --extra dev` becomes
   `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics`. `uv.lock` ALREADY contains lizard 1.23.0, so
   no lock update and no `uv lock --check` drift. `make worktree` delegates to `make install`,
   so worktree venvs are covered by the same change.
2. `Makefile` `install-unlocked` fallback: `pip install -e '.[dev]'` becomes `'.[dev,metrics]'`.
3. Document the two NON-Python tools. scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) cannot come from a Python
   extra, so they need a documented install step -- `docs/local-dev-env.md` is the natural home.
   Their absence must remain a clean `Unavailable`, never a hard failure: a contributor without
   them must still be able to run everything else.

## Explicitly NOT in scope

- Adding a `[code_health]` section to `rebar.toml` (scan_roots / size_cap). That is real
  dogfooding config and should follow the scc bug being fixed, otherwise it would enshrine the
  broken zero.
- `code_health.enabled` is INERT (bug a573-00ea-2bf6-4eb1) -- do not set it expecting an effect.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `make install` provisions lizard; a fresh `make worktree` venv can `import lizard`.
- [ ] `uv lock --check` still passes (no lock drift), proving the metrics extra was already locked.
- [ ] `docs/local-dev-env.md` documents installing scc and jscpd, and states that their absence
      degrades to `Unavailable` rather than failing.
- [ ] A contributor WITHOUT scc/jscpd can still run `make install`, `make lint`, `make typecheck`
      and the suite -- verified, not assumed.
- [ ] CI is unaffected, or the change to CI is explicit and justified.
data.title: Install the metrics analyzer toolchain by default so every new project venv can run code-health metrics
